data.title: Rejection of extended closing-hours exemption for Café "Fleetblick"
data.case_title: Rejection of extended closing-hours exemption for Café "Fleetblick"
data.summary: Bezirksamt Beispielbek (Fachamt Verbraucherschutz, Gewerbe und Umwelt) rejected Lavinia Beispielfleet's request to extend the closing-hours exemption (Sperrzeit-Ausnahme) that would have let her café "Fleetblick" stay open until 2 a.m. on Fridays and Saturdays, citing repeated noise complaints from neighbours and three police interventions. The letter states an objection (Widerspruch) can be filed within one month of notification.
data.explanation: The district office refused to extend your café's late-opening exemption because of recurring noise complaints and police call-outs. You can decide whether to file an objection (Widerspruch) against this rejection with the Bezirksamt; the app will show you the deadline to do so. If you do nothing by that date, the rejection becomes final and the earlier, shorter closing times continue to apply. Consider seeking advice (e.g. from a lawyer or your Handelskammer) if you want to challenge the decision, since you would need to show the noise concerns are addressed.
